# Performance at a glance

Every figure on this page is read from a benchmark artifact in this repository by `scripts/generate-performance-page.py`; a measurement with no artifact reads "not measured". Each table compares only runs of one workload and configuration. Raw runs and provenance are under [Provenance](#provenance).

## Codec cost

ergon against sbe-tool on equal work. The ratio is ergon / sbe-tool (the range over invocations when the run repeated); the verdict is the gate's (`scripts/check-bench-gate.sh`). INCONCLUSIVE passes the gate but is not parity: no winner is established. Method and ceilings: [Benchmarks](../sbe/benchmarks.md).

### Codec cost distribution

Per arm, runs of one profile pooled over every invocation. n is the number of Criterion samples; min, p50, p99, p99.99 and max are percentiles of the per-sample cost (ns per iteration for sbe codecs, ns per operation for cluster codecs). A sample is the mean of a batch of iterations, so these are not per-message tails: the max is the slowest sample's mean, and with n below 10,000 p99.99 is that max. Each max is unexplained: the host was shared with other jobs while these ran, so a spike may be preemption or cache pollution; the next experiment is a rerun on an isolated CPU.

The failover tests (`cluster-test-harness/tests/failover.rs` and `failover_own_driver.rs`) check that the client reconnects to the new leader within a deadline, not how long it takes.

## Host scheduling gaps

A busy-spin loop on an isolated CPU, with helper load on the pod's shared CPU: every loop iteration in ns, reps of one arm pooled. n is loop iterations; p50, p99 and p99.99 are histogram bucket upper bounds; min is the lowest bucket's bound; max is exact. Gap-log drops are gaps the probe could not log, not lost messages. Setup and fixes: [Shared CPUs](../deploy/shared-cpus.md).

| arm | reps | n | min | p50 | p99 | p99.99 | max | gap-log drops | max cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| plugin-on | 3 | 7,463,469,071 | ≤ 8 | 24 | 32 | 32 | 5,520 | 0 | [host stall below the guest kernel (hypervisor or hardware)](https://github.com/mimran1980/ergon/blob/main/k8s/nri-shared-cpus/BENCHMARKS.md#the-floor-below-the-guest-kernel) (rep 3: 0 involuntary switches (rep total); interrupts overlapping: nothing counted) |

Under ftrace (trace): the tracer adds its own cost, so these are not comparable with the table above.

| arm | reps | n | min | p50 | p99 | p99.99 | max | gap-log drops | max cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| trace | 1 | 2,488,258,738 | ≤ 8 | 24 | 32 | 32 | 40,608 | 0 | [preemption: a kworker LRU drain after systemd's daily generators (node event)](https://github.com/mimran1980/ergon/blob/main/k8s/nri-shared-cpus/BENCHMARKS.md#remaining-risk-node-events) (rep 1: 1 involuntary switch (rep total); interrupts overlapping: IPI0 Rescheduling interrupts +1, IPI1 Function call interrupts +1) |
